newer_changes_search: Web search (pmindia.gov.in, PIB, sansad.in, state pages) for 2025-2026 PMAY-G changes: unit assistance still Rs 1.20 / 1.30 lakh; Cabinet approval covers April 2024 to March 2029 with continuation beyond March 2026 subject to NITI Aayog evaluation and EFC re-appraisal; no outcome of that review found, but the portal snapshot (25/10/2026) shows the scheme active with Awaas+ 2024 survey circulars dated Aug-Sep 2026. No renaming or discontinuation found. MGNREGS -> VB-G RAM G change (1 July 2026) is already reflected.

findings.note: The Cabinet release makes continuation beyond March 2026 subject to NITI Aayog evaluation and EFC re-appraisal. No official document confirming that outcome is cited, though the portal shows the scheme running in Sep-Oct 2026.
findings.suggestion: When available, add the post-March-2026 continuation order or a 2026 PIB/Lok Sabha reply; keep reverify_days at 180 or lower.

findings.note: Quote begins with the unrelated item 'Any member of the family earning more than Rs.15,000 per month' before 'Paying income tax'. It still supports the rule.
findings.suggestion: Optionally trim to 'Paying income tax Paying professional tax' or keep as is.

findings.note: The 2024 exclusion criteria (Rs 15,000, deleted two-wheeler etc.) apply to the Awaas+ 2024 survey; families on the older SECC 2011 PWL were screened under the earlier criteria. The 2024 PIB annexure also notes Telangana and Puducherry were not implementing PMAY-G.
findings.suggestion: Consider a short note that state participation and list screening vary; check at the block office.
